name: Bluedot Poshtel Myeongdong
detail: There were curtains on the bed, which was nice for ensuring a bit of privacy. The lockers can have their numbers changed by anyone, so I locked my valuables in my suitcase. There were no bed bugs. The large public bath was a joy for Japanese people, and it was usually not crowded, making it easy to use. Although it could only be used from 16:00 to 22:00 and the bath was a bit too hot, it was understandable considering the accommodation fee was low, and it was relatively clean. There were separate changing rooms for the women's and men's baths, which made changing easy. There were also several toilets separate from the showers! I had brought a bento box for my business trip stay in Seoul, but I was told they couldn't hold refrigerated items before check-in, which was a hassle. There were conveniences such as a freezer, refrigerator, microwave, water purifier, hot water, and dish soap. Be careful as they will only hold your luggage until 17:00 after check-out. The location was right in the heart of Myeongdong, making it convenient to access both Euljiro 1(il)ga Station and Myeongdong Station. I highly recommend it for those who aren't bothered by dormitory-style accommodations. It was clean, reasonably priced, and overall a great experience. You will need: toothbrush, toothpaste, loungewear, sandals/slippers, shampoo, conditioner, a charger with a plug type, and wet wipes.

name: First Cabin International Seoul Myeongdong
detail: Since it was newly built, the interior was very clean and had a sense of freshness. The interior was spacious, and the storage space in the beds was larger compared to other hostels and capsule hotels, making it suitable for those with a lot of luggage to stay comfortably. Additionally, there was ample space to spread out a suitcase and organize belongings, which was very convenient. The bed itself had a firm mattress and was comfortable to sleep on, allowing me to spend time there without feeling cramped. The location was also excellent, as it was just a short walk from Euljiro Entrance Station, making travel convenient. Furthermore, there were many shower rooms, toilets, and sinks available, so even when the usage times overlapped with other guests, there was hardly any waiting, which was also appealing. On the other hand, I found the entrance a bit hard to find. Particularly when checking in at night, you would have to enter from the parking lot side, which might cause confusion for first-time visitors. I think it would be reassuring to confirm the location of the entrance in advance. Overall, I am very satisfied with the cleanliness, location, and quality of the facilities. It’s a hostel where I can spend time comfortably, so I would definitely like to use it again when I visit Korea.

name: Takt_Jongno - Female Only Capsule Hotel
detail: The location is very good. There are places like Ppossamu Street and Oryang within walking distance. One station away is Gwangjang Market, and on the day I returned home, I was able to enjoy Yukhoe and Kkwabaegi in the morning, which was fantastic. Even after checking out, I was able to leave my luggage, so I could enjoy my time light until my flight. Regarding hygiene, both the toilet and shower room are clean. As a caution, the bedroom was dry, and I had a sore throat when I woke up in the morning, so I think measures like a mask and moisturization are necessary.

name: MOOGM Euljiro
detail: The bus stop and subway are very close, safe even in the early morning or at night, allowing you to go anywhere. With excellent access, I would quickly return to drop off my shopping when my bags got heavy. There is also a convenience store nearby. (From Gimpo Airport, you can get there directly by subway without any transfers. There is a limousine bus stop next to the subway station for Incheon Airport.) There are many markets and restaurants within walking distance, and the river flowing in front of the hotel has clean water, making it pleasant to walk to Dongdaemun. The room and facilities were simple, clean, stylish, and comfortable. There is a powerful hairdryer, a curling iron, and amenities like shampoo, body soap, toothbrushes, and earplugs are provided. (I found it convenient to bring disposable slippers for indoor use, the shower room, and the toilet.) The check-in and check-out system was easy and quick, saving time. I stayed alone for three nights, and it was sufficient just for sleeping. I would like to use this hotel again when I come to Korea alone.

name: Hanok Hotel Daam
detail: I stayed in a dormitory for 3 nights. Although it's called a dormitory, it's not a bunk bed setup, so the ceiling is high, allowing for changing clothes while standing. The location is excellent. The National Palace and Insadong are within walking distance, and both Anguk Station and Jongno Samga Station are accessible. There are plenty of convenience stores and restaurants in the area. I was also satisfied with the breakfast, which included a daily soup, salad, bread, fried rice, eggs, sautéed vegetables, and fruit. There are several staff members who speak fluent Japanese. The only downside is that there seemed to be a lack of washrooms (including handwashing facilities in the toilet) compared to the overall facilities. The facility itself was very clean, and overall I was satisfied.

name: Solo Stay Myeongdong
detail: Check-in can basically be done through messaging, so it was smooth to use. The clientele was calm, with no one being noisy, allowing for a comfortable stay. Above all, the location is excellent! It’s within a 5-minute walk to subway lines 1 and 2, and within 10 minutes to line 4, making it convenient for travel. Just outside the room, there's a Seven-Eleven and a convenience store called 25, and Starbucks is just a 1-minute walk away. Lotte Department Store is right in front as well. I think having this location at this price is quite rare. Not only is it affordable, but it's also close to the station, well-equipped, and includes free breakfast, which is highly rated. The only drawback is that since it’s a capsule hotel, the air in the room can feel stagnant. For those concerned, it might be good to bring a small USB-powered fan. The room also had USB Type-C outlets and a mirror, which was convenient. Considering the location, cleanliness, and price overall, it's a hotel I would definitely like to use again!

name: Hotel MyeongDong Station
detail: The water facilities, which Japanese people often pay attention to, were clean, and both the toilet and shower were well-maintained. It was also a great point that it was very close to Myeongdong Station, allowing for sightseeing right after arriving. Since I checked in late and checked out early, I didn’t really interact with the staff. The breakfast, though light, was prepared and was appreciated. I thought it would have been nice if I could have had something to eat during the night outside of the specified hours, even if it meant an extra charge. I went in early September, but I noticed that the air conditioning in the corridor was a bit cold. However, since it was a private room, my personal space was respected and noise wasn’t much of a concern.

name: Snow Flower Guest House
detail: I have stayed at several hotels in Korea within the same budget, and this one was the best! First of all, Hyehwa Station has Line 4, which was really convenient!!! There are many universities around the station, so there are a lot of young people, and there are cafes and eateries! The toilet and washing machine are shared, but they seem to be cleaned daily, so it's very clean. The kitchen is also shared. Drinks like zero-calorie cola, Sprite, water, sparkling water, and orange juice are available at any time. There are also bread, rice, and instant noodles, so it’s possible to have all meals at the hotel! The only thing that bothered me was that a few tomatoes were rotten 😭 The shower room inside the room had no leaks and no unpleasant smell. The ventilation fan seems to be powerful, so it can quickly dry up the shower room! The TV is large and convenient. The hairdryer has strong airflow. There were eight hangers in the room. There was one large bath towel and two small bath towels in the room. The refrigerator was larger than I expected. There were three outlets on the desk! The plugs are compatible with Korean plugs. It was a very good place for a long stay. Thank you so much!!! Thank you 😊

name: Seoul Garden Hotel
detail: I had to move to the airport early in the morning, so I stayed somewhere close to the airport bus stop. Both Gongdeok Station and Mapo Station are nearby, and especially, the bus stop is really right in front! There are also convenience stores and supermarkets close by, which was nice. It requires a bit of transfer to go sightseeing, but the stations are all close, so it was okay. The staff seemed to have some varied personalities, but the person who checked me in and the one who did the room cleaning were very kind. They provided detailed explanations and spoke Japanese well, so my friend who was with me felt comfortable too. However, there’s no facial cleanser or toothbrush and toothpaste... Also, the bathroom door doesn’t close or lock (it doesn’t close at all...) I found it a bit inconvenient and just used it, but I think it needs to be fixed. The room is spacious, and the refrigerator works really well. There’s plenty of space for my things. The bed is on the smaller side, but it was reasonably comfortable. I made a cheap reservation, so I think it’s good value for money.

name: Roynet Hotel Seoul Mapo
detail: This hotel is five years old and is very well maintained. The cleanliness is impeccable, and the ventilation in the rooms is good, making for a pleasant stay. I especially liked the bathroom. These days, many business hotels don't have bathtubs and have small bathrooms, but here the bathroom is as spacious as the room and has a separate bathtub, which made it very convenient for bathing and getting ready. The bedding is not overly fluffy but just the right amount of cozy, which I liked. Hotels of this condition at this price are rare given the rising hotel prices in Seoul, so I think I will frequently use this place during business trips.
